description: Example fixture list (spec §11.2). Copy this into your own private set; this file is a schema example and seeds no real ground truth.

bugs.note: Bounded the length read before the copy. Counts as surfaced if any candidate lands in the range.
No line range recorded, so any candidate in this file that names the symbol counts. A file-level match is reported as a weaker basis than a range match.

fixtures.note: A negative control. Seeding no bugs is deliberate: recall is undefined for this fixture and only its precision means anything.
